feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iterations 0 to 5 show max_error pinned at 0.0601 to 0.0628 on every track (iteration 0 at 0.0618 to 0.0691, with line losses). Line losses were removed by a span of ±0.05 or wider (iterations 2 and 4), so sensing coverage is fixed. wheel_track 0.10 vs 0.12 (iteration 3 vs 2) and ki 0.05 vs 0.5 gave identical metrics, and wheel_radius 0.035 moved only oval max_error (0.0614 to 0.0601, iteration 4). Mass 0.6 (iteration 5) also left the floor unchanged. What I had to do in the controller: nothing changed in the gains, so the lookahead test is not confounded. The main risk is that the longer lookahead adds phase lag on slalom; slalom steering_oscillation was 0.159 at y=0.03 with ±0.04 (iteration 1), so watch it. Next race: if max_error on oval and s-bend falls below about 0.058 with line_loss_events at 0, keep y=0.06 and tune the span toward ±0.055. If the floor stays at 0.060 to 0.062, lookahead is ruled out and the next geometry test should change the footprint or width.
requested_changes: If max_error stays at 0.060 to 0.062 with y=0.06 and no line losses, lookahead is ruled out: try sensor_size 0.008 with span ±0.05 and y=0.06, because the 16 mm footprint has not been compared with a smaller one and the 25 mm tape still spans a 25 mm pitch at this size.

If max_error on oval and s-bend falls below about 0.058 with line_loss_events at 0, keep y=0.06 and try outer sensors at x = ±0.055, because iteration 2 (±0.06) removed line losses and iteration 4 (±0.05) did too, so the span can move between them to recover slalom progress.

If slalom steering_oscillation rises above about 0.15 at y=0.06, move the row to y=0.045 as an intermediate step, because iteration 1 at y=0.03 showed 0.159 oscillation and iteration 0 at y=0.05 showed 0.148, so the oscillation rises with lookahead.
